concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading from both Materials Project AND OQMD. Task T004c (validators.py) hardcodes a whitelist containing only 'https://materialsproject.org' and an empty string. There is no task to add the OQMD URL to this whitelist, meaning the pipeline will fail validation for OQMD data, violating FR-001.

FR-003 requires generating segregation energies for 'at least [deferred] configurations' across multiple alloy systems. Tasks T017a-1 and T017b hardcode the NIST EAM potential specifically for Fe-Cr. There is no task to download, configure, or select potentials for other alloy systems, creating a scope gap where the system cannot satisfy FR-003 for non-Fe-Cr alloys.

Spec Edge Cases require filtering bulk configurations with 'zero impurity atoms' and logging the count to a preprocessing report. Task T019 is marked as rejected/missing in the plan notes, and no active task in the list implements this specific filtering logic and report generation.

SC-001 requires measuring R² against a test set of 'at least [deferred] held-out alloy systems' and determining significance via permutation testing. Task T025b implements the permutation testing but lacks a corresponding task to dynamically determine or enforce the sample size threshold for the held-out systems, risking a test set too small to satisfy the SC.

The 'Re-plan' section (implied by the Analyze Report) explicitly rejected these tasks for missing artifacts, yet they remain in the list marked as `[X]` (completed) or `[ ]` (pending) without a corresponding 'Revised Task' entry to address the specific missing files (e.g., collinearity_report.md, preprocessing_report.json). This creates a contradiction where the task list claims work that is currently unverifiable.

The Plan (plan.md) explicitly instructs to 'Apply PCA to descriptors' in Phase 1, which contradicts Spec FR-007 and Task T015 (retain raw descriptors). While T015 correctly rejects PCA, the Plan's instruction remains in the text, creating a risk of implementer confusion. A task or note explicitly resolving this contradiction in the Plan text is missing.
